s1.instructions: Step 1 of the P0 canary. Create a file named canary-start.txt in the current working directory containing exactly the text p0-canary. Then call the statewright transition tool with event GO and no other arguments.

s2.instructions: This state forks into two parallel branch sessions (a and b) that run automatically; both must finish before the join. Call the statewright transition tool with event DONE to start the fork. Do not run any shell commands in this state.

a1.instructions: Branch A: create a file named canary-branch-a.txt in the current working directory containing exactly the text branch-a. Verify the file exists, then call the statewright transition tool with event DONE.

b1.instructions: Branch B: create a file named canary-branch-b.txt in the current working directory containing exactly the text branch-b. Verify the file exists, then call the statewright transition tool with event DONE.

s3.instructions: Both branches have completed. Call the statewright transition tool with event DONE to finish the workflow.
